recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: claude code workflows finding their folder structure
ai ethics desks quietly emptying out
platform giants asked to share the same rulebook
san francisco summer fog rolling in at dusk
late august evenings still stretching past eight

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Thread a tiny drone through drifting Karl the Fog banks above SF hills — hold to rise, release to sink, catching brief gaps before the gray swallows you.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each clean gap feels like a stolen glimpse of the bridge
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog banks thicken, drift faster, and gaps shrink

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag scattered code snippets into nested folder bins before context window fills — the directory tree sprouts new branches mid-round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying snap when a messy desk collapses into a clean tree
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: new folder branches spawn and snippets multiply
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green on cream paper cutouts

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap deploy buttons in rhythm to ship features before sunrise — each beat must land on the timeline as the sky shifts from indigo to gold.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: streak of perfect deploys as dawn breaks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: feature queue grows and tempo accelerates
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: gradient sky wash from night to amber

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick ethics tokens onto twin balance scales — keep both sides level as moral weights drop in unpredictable bursts.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one breath of perfect equilibrium before the scales tip
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: weights get heavier and arrive in faster clusters
